instructions_to_main_agent: 1. SETUP: Install 'lucide-react' (already standard), 'recharts' for charts, 'framer-motion' for transitions, 'date-fns' and 'date-fns-tz' for time logic.
2. THEME: Implement the 'Swiss Utility' theme. Use 'Outfit' font for headings (load from Google Fonts) and 'Inter' for body.
3. LANDING PAGE: Build a custom landing page. Hero section must have the 'Omnibar' (AI Input) visual as the main call to action. Use the 'Bento Grid' layout for features.
4. DASHBOARD: Create a clean, tabbed interface (Time / Currency / History). The 'AI Input' should be persistent at the top.
5. TIME ZONE: Use a horizontal scrolling list or grid of cards for selected cities. Highlight overlap hours visually (e.g., green segments on a timeline bar).
6. CURRENCY: Use a simple input pair (From/To) and a 'Sparkline' chart using Recharts (AreaChart with gradient).
7. AI LOGIC: Mock the LLM intent parsing if real API is not available, or use a simple regex/heuristic router for MVP (e.g., 'convert' -> currency, 'time' -> timezone).
8. ACCESSIBILITY: Ensure all text inputs have labels (even if visually hidden). Use high contrast text.
9. ANIMATION: Add subtle entrance animations (fade-in-up) for dashboard cards using framer-motion.
10. TESTING: Add 'data-testid' to all inputs, buttons, and result displays.
universal_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry.
All interactive elements must have hover states.
Never use 'transparent' background on dropdowns/modals; use blurred semi-transparent backgrounds.
